aiActivity.title: AI activity
aiActivity.description: What AI agents and integrations did in this company: every allowed and denied write attempt from the Core audit. Level A may only read, level B may also create tasks, and level C proposes data changes (e.g. CRM clients) that a person must approve in the app and that can be reverted in bulk.
aiActivity.unavailable: The audit records could not be loaded.
aiActivity.emptyDescription: As soon as an AI agent changes something in this company, or tries to, it appears here.

sidePanel.resize: Resize panel. Drag or use the left and right arrows. Double-click or Home restores the default width.

people.title: People and roles
people.description: Accounts of people in {{company}}: roles, access and deactivation. Every change runs a governed Core action and is written to the audit trail.

roles.title: Company roles
roles.hint: A proposed minimal role configuration, not a customer-approved matrix. Role permissions are copied from a reference persona.

audit.title: People administration audit trail
audit.empty: No changes yet. Create an account or change a role and the entry appears here.
audit.rejected: an account administration attempt was denied ({{code}})
audit.inactiveRejected: – the deactivated account sent a request; Core rejected it

codes.company_administrator_required: the user is not a company administrator

forbidden.title: Only the company administrator manages people
forbidden.description: Your account has no administrator role in this company. Core evaluates permissions on the server; hiding buttons is not a security boundary.

signedOut.title: You are signed out
signedOut.description: Sign in again. A deactivated account is rejected.

error.title: People could not be loaded
error.description: The service is temporarily unavailable. Try again.

form.createDescription: The account is created in Core (principal + sign-in binding) and receives the permissions of the selected role.
form.name: Full name

panel.title: Account
panel.disableHint: Deactivation applies to the whole account (all companies). Core rejects the account's next request.
panel.enableHint: The account signs in again with the same role.
panel.selfHint: You cannot change your own account or permissions.
panel.sharedHint: The account also belongs to other companies; the role changes only in this company.

crm.roleHint: The account also joins the CRM salespeople, so clients can be assigned to it.
crm.registered: {{name}} was added to the CRM salespeople
crm.registeredHint: They can receive clients and will see them in CRM › My clients.
crm.reactivated: Salesperson {{name}} is active in the CRM again
crm.reactivatedHint: They can receive clients again; earlier history was kept.
crm.retired: {{name}} was retired from the CRM salespeople
crm.retiredHint: They receive no new clients; their client history stays.
crm.registerFailed: The account could not be added to the CRM salespeople
crm.retireFailed: The salesperson could not be retired in the CRM
crm.failedHint: Finish it in CRM › Clients › Salespeople.

errors.conflict: Conflict: the e-mail is taken or the account changed meanwhile. Refresh the list.

errors.signedOut: Your session expired, sign in again.

operators.title: Who may connect the agent
operators.hint: Only people of {{company}} can be chosen.
operators.empty: Nobody may connect this agent yet.

list.title: Agent connections
list.empty: The agent is not connected to any app yet.
list.dialogDescription: The app loses access as the agent within 30 seconds. The reason is written to the audit log.

editor.createDescription: The agent acts only in the modules and with the rights you give it here. Only the people you choose may connect it.
editor.name: Agent name
editor.modulesHint: The same rights as people have: read, or read and write.

read_only.label: Read only
read_only.description: The agent changes nothing, it only reads.

approval.label: Through approval
approval.description: The agent only proposes changes; a person carries them out in Settings › Approvals.

direct.label: Directly
direct.description: The agent writes on its own in modules with write access. Every change is audited.

editor.readOnlyIgnoresWrite: In Read only mode the agent writes nothing, not even in modules with write access.
editor.operatorsHint: These people can connect it to ChatGPT or Claude by choosing “As the agent”. No keys are copied.

errors.nameTooLong: The name can have at most 200 characters.
errors.descriptionTooLong: The description can have at most 500 characters.
errors.ownerRequired: Choose who is responsible for the agent.

section.title: Agent entities
section.description: An agent is a separate identity of the company with its own permissions. It connects to ChatGPT or Claude through OntOS by choosing “As the agent”; no keys or tokens are issued here.
section.empty: The company has no agent yet.
section.emptyHint: Create an agent with New agent and set its permissions.
section.disabledNotice: The agent is deactivated. Its connections were revoked; after activation it has to be connected again.

dialog.deactivateDescription: The agent loses access immediately and all its connections are revoked. The reason is written to the audit trail.
dialog.activateDescription: The agent gets its permissions back. It has to be connected again.
dialog.deleteDescription: The agent loses all permissions, connections and the list of people who may connect it, and leaves the list. Audit records stay.

audit.title: Agent change history
audit.denied: denied attempt to change an agent
